reader.requirement: At --std 85 GROUP INDICATE must be refused unless it is written in an entry of a DETAIL report group that defines a printable item, which §1985:III.2 defines as an elementary report entry containing a COLUMN NUMBER clause, a PICTURE clause and a SOURCE, SUM or VALUE clause.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 runs the 1985 Table 1 screen (PICTURE and SOURCE or VALUE requirements of the GROUP INDICATE rows); DialectLevel >= 2002 asks the SOURCE-or-VALUE half directly; the detail-group and COLUMN halves are common; the message text differs
VALUE-implied PICTURE refused below 2002 (COBOL0900), seen on the PICTURE-less probe

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 PICTURE is part of the printable-item definition (a PICTURE-less VALUE entry is refused), at 2002+ a VALUE may imply the picture
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover a non-detail group and a missing COLUMN; the missing SOURCE/VALUE, missing PICTURE, group entry and SUM cases are not exercised

probes.expected: accepted in a detail group with COLUMN, PICTURE and SOURCE or VALUE; GR1 shows the items on the first presentation and after the control break, spaces otherwise

probes.printed: COBOL2519 ... is in a CONTROL HEADING report group
COBOL2519 ... is in a CONTROL FOOTING report group
COBOL2519 ... is in a PAGE FOOTING report group (plus unrelated LINE/PAGE errors)
COBOL2519 ... is in a REPORT HEADING report group (plus an unrelated LINE error)

probes.expected: refused: no COLUMN NUMBER clause, so not a printable item

probes.printed: COBOL2247 PICTURE, COLUMN, GROUP INDICATE ... (SOURCE required and missing) (ISO §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR11)
probes.expected: refused: no SOURCE, SUM or VALUE

probes.printed: COBOL2247 ... (PICTURE required and missing); COBOL0900 VALUE-implied PICTURE requires COBOL-2002
COBOL2247 ... is a group entry and writes GROUP INDICATE (cites ISO §2023:13.15.3 SR11)
probes.expected: refused: a group entry is not an elementary report entry

probes.printed: COBOL2247 GROUP INDICATE not permitted with SUM; COBOL2519 in a CONTROL FOOTING group

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.13.3 SR1  (3.13.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1
OK  §1985:III.2  (2. DEFINITIONS)  the text is in the clause [quote: This elementary report entry contains a COLUMN NUMBER clause, a PICTURE clause, and a SOURCE, SUM, or VALUE clause]
OK  §1985:XIII.3.13.4 GR1 [quote: it causes the SOURCE or VALUE clause to be ignored and spaces supplied]

reader.notes: Every part of the 1985 printable-item definition is enforced at 85: the detail-group and COLUMN halves by ScreenReportEntryClausePresence, PICTURE and SOURCE/SUM/VALUE by the 1985 Table 1 screen. The group-entry refusal cites §2023:13.15.3 SR11 at --std 85 (a citation-text blemish only; the verdict is right).

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: ga1 a three-level detail group (01 TYPE DETAIL, 02 LINE PLUS 1 entries, 03 format 3 items) with GROUP alone (INDICATE omitted) and GROUP INDICATE accepted; report 11 1 / VAL 1 / '   2' / '     2' / 22 3 / VAL 3, the indicated items shown first and after the CY break. Refusals: gb1 GROUP INDICATE on a format 2 LINE entry and gb2 on the format 1 01 entry (COBOL2247, the second citing §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR3, SR4a), gb3 COLUMN + PIC + GROUP INDICATE with no SOURCE/VALUE (COBOL2247, 1985 Table 1). Later-edition forms on the entry: gc3 COLUMN PLUS 2 (COBOL0900 requires COBOL-2002) and gc4 PRESENT WHEN (COBOL0900 plus COBOL1559) are refused. In 1985 a format 1 entry is never elementary (§1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR4), so there is no 01-level printable item to test. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.13.3 SR1 [must only be specified in a detail report group entry that defines a printable item]; OK §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR4d.
